basics.name: Rodrigo Cortés Sánchez
basics.label: AI Systems Engineer
basics.summary: AI Systems Engineer specializing in multi-agent systems for reliable production environments. Experienced in designing and orchestrating distributed systems across cloud, edge, and embedded contexts, with a focus on system evaluation, interoperability, and real-world constraints. Background spans LLM-based agentic systems, microservices, and real-time embedded software.

work.name: Circontrol
work.summary: Designed and operated distributed microservices for smart electrical grids and energy management systems in production environments.
highlights: Designed and implemented distributed microservices enabling real-time coordination of energy systems using Go and Docker
Integrated heterogeneous communication protocols (MQTT, Modbus, REST, gRPC) to achieve device-agnostic control and monitoring
Improved system reliability and fault tolerance for continuous grid operation through robust service design

work.name: BSV Electronic
work.summary: Developed embedded firmware and control systems for industrial automation under hard real-time and cost constraints.
highlights: Engineered C/C++ firmware for STM32 and ESP32 platforms with deterministic real-time behavior
Optimized system architecture for energy efficiency and reduced hardware cost
Integrated sensor networks and control loops for autonomous industrial systems

work.name: Altair Engineering
work.summary: Contributed to core development of large-scale simulation software for engineering workflows.
highlights: Optimized performance-critical components in C++ core libraries
Improved software reliability through structured testing and integration practices

work.name: Traxión Logistics
work.summary: Built data infrastructure to support logistics network optimization and operational decision-making.
highlights: Designed ETL pipelines and business intelligence dashboards for logistics operations
Implemented route optimization algorithms to reduce transportation cost and delivery time

projects.name: AI-Powered Personal Health Assistant
projects.summary: Designed and evaluated a multi-agent system for personalized health insights using wearable and health record data.
highlights: Designed a multi-agent architecture with specialized agents for data analysis, domain reasoning, and user interaction
Integrated heterogeneous data sources including wearables and structured health records
Developed evaluation methods to assess reliability and reasoning consistency of agentic systems
Implemented prototype using general-purpose large language models

projects.name: LLM-Based CV Processor System
projects.summary: Built an LLM-driven system for structured document extraction and synthesis.
highlights: Implemented multi-step LLM orchestration using LangChain
Designed pipelines for document parsing, semantic extraction, and structured output generation
